title: Update for Study on Integrated Shield Plan Portability and Measures to Safeguard Policyholders' Interests
what_it_is: Update for Study on Integrated Shield Plan Portability and Measures to Safeguard Policyholders' Interests

sections.label: Integrated Shield Plan portability study update
sections.summary: Asked when the Ministry will update its study on making Integrated Shield Plan insurance portable and what measures beyond the status quo can safeguard policyholders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health (a) when will the Ministry provide the next update regarding its study on whether Integrated Shield Plan (IP) insurance can be made portable in a way that is helpful for existing and future policyholders; and (b) what measures can be considered beyond the status quo to better safeguard the interests and market bargaining power of IP policyholders who currently face difficulty switching IP providers after their existing providers have significantly changed the de facto terms of policy coverage and access to policy benefits.

sections.label: MediShield Life enhancements announced
sections.summary: MOH announced enhancements for MediShield Life to be progressively implemented from April 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Last month, MOH announced a set of enhancements for MediShield Life which will be progressively implemented from April 2025.

sections.label: MOH rejects mandating full IP portability
sections.summary: MOH does not believe mandating full portability for Integrated Shield Plans is the right solution for policyholders' issues.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For these reasons, MOH does not believe that mandating full portability for IPs is the right solution for the issues faced by policyholders.

sections.label: MediShield Life covers pre-existing conditions
sections.summary: The Government ensures MediShield Life covers policyholders with pre-existing conditions even if private insurance does not.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For IP policyholders with pre-existing conditions, the assurance for them is that the Government always stepped in to ensure that MediShield Life will cover them for their pre-existing conditions, even if their private insurance does not.

sections.label: IP insurers' social responsibility and sustainability
sections.summary: IP insurers must have social responsibility towards policyholders, including ensuring their products are sustainable, since MediSave can pay premiums.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And the Member highlighted the point about the IP products being of a special category, because you can tap on your MediSave to pay for your premiums.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, certainly, we agree that the IP insurers must have a sense of social responsibility towards policyholders and this includes ensuring that their products are sustainable.

sections.label: Health portfolios barely breaking even or losing
sections.summary: Companies are either barely breaking even or making losses from their health portfolios, which is an issue of concern.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: What we are seeing is that the companies are either barely breaking even or making losses from their health portfolios, and this is an issue of concern.

sections.label: Ministry concerns private policies sustainability
sections.summary: The Ministry is concerned that private policies may not be sustainable due to a race to the bottom.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And this is where the Ministry's concerns lie and this is what the Member alluded to.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We need to take a close look at this because there appears to be a race to the bottom and we are constantly worried that these private policies are not sustainable.
